Annual Report |website=bseindia.com|accessdate=26 June 2023}} | assets_year = | equity = {{increase}} {{INRConvert|1330.54|c}} (2022) | equity_year = | owners = | num_employees = | num_employees_year = | divisions = | subsidiaries = | module = | website = {{URL|https://www.texmaco.in/}} | footnotes = }} '''Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd.''' is an Indian engineering and infrastructure company that is primarily engaged in manufacturing [[Railroad car|railway wagons]], [[Passenger railroad car|coaches]], and [[Locomotive|locomotives]], as well as providing related services. The company is part of Adventz Group and headquartered in [[Kolkata]]. The company manufactures coaches for the [[Indian Railways]] and private firms.{{Cite web |date=2023-03-09 |title=Texmaco Rail & Engineering gears up to meet demand for more wagons |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/economy/logistics/texmaco-rail-engineering-gears-up-to-meet-demand-for-more-wagons/article66598745.ece |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}} == Operations == Texmaco Rail and Engineering Ltd is involved in the business of manufacturing of rolling stock, such as wagons, coaches, EMUs, loco shells & parts, etc., hydro mechanical equipment, steel castings, rail EPC, bridges and other steel structures.{{Cite news |date=2023-04-20 |title=Texmaco Rail & Engineering partners with NYMWAG CS to make freight wagons |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/texmaco-rail-engineering-partners-with-nymwag-cs-to-make-freight-wagons/articleshow/99646973.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-05-31 |issn=0971-8257}} It has supplied its products to Indian Railways, private freight operators, and metro rail projects in India. The company also exports its rolling stock and services to international markets.{{Cite web |last=Mukherjee |first=Ritwik |date=2023-03-23 |title=Texmaco Rail & Engineering bags railway project in Rwanda |url=https://www.bizzbuzz.news/trendz/texmaco-rail-engineering-bags-railway-project-in-rwanda-1206527 |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=www.bizzbuzz.news |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Texmaco Rail & Engineering eyes more acquisitions for expansion |url=https://www.vccircle.com/texmaco-rail-engineering-eyes-more-acquisitions-expansion |access-date=2023-06-08 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}} Apart from manufacturing rolling stock, Texmaco Rail and Engineering Ltd is involved in executing infrastructure projects related to railways and urban transport systems. It undertakes the construction of railway bridges, signalling systems, electrification, and track laying, among other aspects of railway infrastructure.{{Cite web |last=www.ETInfra.com |title=Texmaco Rail bags Rs 252 cr order for Indore Metro - ET Infra |url=https://infra.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/urban-transportation/texmaco-rail-bags-rs-252-cr-order-for-indore-metro/95123068 |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=ETInfra.com |language=en}}{{Cite news |date=2023-04-28 |title=Texmaco builds country's largest spillway radial gates for Subansiri hydropower project |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/construction/texmaco-builds-countrys-largest-spillway-radial-gates-for-subansiri-hydropower-project/articleshow/99853556.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-05-31 |issn=0013-0389}} Texmaco Rail and Engineering Ltd has partnerships with Wabtec Corporation (formerly GE Transportation) and Nymburk, among others.{{Cite web |last=www.ETAuto.com |title=Texmaco inksfreight car JV with Slovak Co - ET Auto |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/automotive/texmaco-inksfreight-car-jv-with-slovak-co/99694928 |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=ETAuto.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Texmaco gets a pie of Rs 40,000 crore GE and Alstom contracts |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-texmaco-gets-a-pie-of-rs-40000-crore-ge-and-alstom-contracts-2448872 |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=DNA India |language=en}} === Subsidiaries=== Texmaco Rail and Engineering Ltd has subsidiaries including Texmaco Infrastructure and Holdings Ltd (focused on infrastructure projects) and Bright Power Projects (India) Pvt Ltd (involved in renewable energy projects).{{Cite web |date=2023-05-15 |title=Texmaco Infra Consolidated March 2023 Net Sales at Rs 4.21 crore, down 49.22% Y-o-Y |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/earnings/texmaco-infra-consolidated-march-2023-net-sales-at-rs-4-21-crore-down-49-22-y-o-y-10586991.html |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2023-03-14 |title=Texmaco Rail board approves transfer of rail EPC units to two separate arms |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/texmaco-rail-board-approves-transfer-of-rail-epc-units-to-two-separate-arms-16167841.htm |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=cnbctv18.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2015-09-16 |title=Texmaco to acquire majority stake in Bright Power Projects |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/texmaco-to-acquire-majority-stake-in-bright-power-projects/article7660012.ece |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}} Texmaco also holds 41% stake in Texmaco Defence Systems Private Ltd. (TDSPL).{{Cite web |title=Texmaco Rail sells 10% stake in defence subsidiary |url=https://www.vccircle.com/texmaco-rail-sells-10-stake-in-defence-subsidiary |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}} == Shareholding == The equity shares of Texmaco Rail & Engineering are listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]], and the [[National Stock Exchange of India]].{{Cite web |date=2023-02-01 |title=From RVNL to IRCON to IRCTC: Railway-related stocks in limelight ahead of Union Budget |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/market-news/news-from-rvnl-to-ircon-to-irctc-railway-related-stocks-in-limelight-ahead-of-union-budget-rvnl-railway-stock-railway-219817 |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=Zee Business}} As on 31 March 2023, Saroj Poddar-led Adventz Group held 58.56% shares in Texmaco Rail & Engineering.{{Cite web |title=Texmaco Rail & Engineering Shareholding Pattern |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/texmaco-rail-engineering-ltd/shareholding/companyid-32984.cms |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=The Economic Times |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Texmaco Rail and Engineering Ltd to double business over five years |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/business/texmaco-rail-and-engineering-limited-to-double-business-over-next-five-years/cid/1830625 |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=www.telegraphindia.com |language=en}} == See also == * [[Rail transport in India]] == References == {{Reflist}} [[Category:Defence companies of India]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Kolkata]] [[Category:Coach and wagon manufacturers of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Freight wagons manufacturers]]
extract: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. is an Indian engineering and infrastructure company that is primarily engaged in manufacturing railway wagons, coaches, and locomotives, as well as providing related services. The company is part of Adventz Group and headquartered in Kolkata. The company manufactures coaches for the Indian Railways and private firms.
